This page lists 95 Adobe Acrobat keyboard shortcuts for macOS, grouped by area. They come from the community `acrobat.keyly` template for [Keyly](/), a free, open-source menu bar app: install the template once, then double-tap `⇪ Caps Lock` in Adobe Acrobat to see them next to the shortcuts Keyly reads from the app's menus.

## Install the template

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/main/scripts/install-templates.sh | bash -s -- -t acrobat.keyly
```

This saves the template to `~/.config/keyly/templates/acrobat.keyly`. It targets `/Applications/Adobe Acrobat DC/Adobe Acrobat.app`; if Adobe Acrobat lives elsewhere on your Mac, [update the app path](/configuration/templates/). New to Keyly? Start with [Getting Started](/getting-started/).

## Tools

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `Space` | Hand tool (temporary) |
| `H` | Pan (Hand) tool |
| `V` | Select tool |
| `Z` | Marquee Zoom |
| `⇧Z` | Cycle zoom tools |
| `R` | Select Object tool |
| `O` | Edit Object tool |
| `A` | Enter/Exit Forms editing |
| `C` | Crop tool |
| `L` | Link tool |
| `F` | Text Field tool |
| `⇧F` | Cycle form tools |
| `T` | Edit text |
| `⇧Y` | Redact |
| `⇧T` | Cycle Touch Up tools |
| `⇧⌘T` | Insert blank pages |
| `⇧⌘I` | Insert files |
| `⇧⌘D` | Delete pages |
| `⇧⌘U` | Touch Up Reading Order |

## Navigation

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⇞` | Previous screen |
| `⇟` | Next screen |
| `Home` | First page |
| `End` | Last page |
| `←` | Previous page |
| `→` | Next page |
| `⌘⇧N` | Go to page |
| `⌘⇞` | Previous page (alt) |
| `⌘⇟` | Next page (alt) |
| `↑` | Scroll up |
| `↓` | Scroll down |
| `⌘=` | Zoom in |
| `⌘-` | Zoom out |

## Task Panes

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `F6` | Cycle focus (Document/Task/Message/Nav) |
| `⇧F6` | Cycle focus reverse |
| `⌥⇥` | Next panel in Task pane |
| `⌘⇧⇥` | Previous panel in Task pane |
| `⇧F4` | Open/Close Task pane |
| `⌃⇧F4` | Close action tasks pane |

## Comments

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `S` | Add a comment tool |
| `K` | Add a stamp tool |
| `J` | Add a stamp tool (alt) |
| `U` | Current highlighting tool |
| `⇧U` | Cycle highlight tools |
| `D` | Current drawing markup |
| `⇧D` | Cycle drawing markup tools |
| `Q` | Cloud tool |
| `X` | Add text comment |
| `⇧J` | Cycle stamp/attach/sound |
| `⇧K` | Add checkmark in Comments list |
| `⏎` | Open pop-up note |
| `R` | Reply to comment |
| `⎋` | Close pop-up note |

## Forms

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `P` | Toggle edit/preview form |
| `G` | Toggle guides |
| `L` | Align fields left |
| `R` | Align fields right |
| `T` | Align fields top |
| `B` | Align fields bottom |
| `H` | Align fields horizontal |
| `V` | Align fields vertical |
| `⇧H` | Center fields horizontally |
| `⇧V` | Center fields vertically |
| `⇧L` | Highlight fields |
| `⇧N` | Show Tab Order |
| `⇧D` | Document JavaScripts |

## General Navigation

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⇧F8` | Move focus to toolbar |
| `⌃⇥` | Next open document tab |
| `⌃⇧⇥` | Previous open document tab |
| `⌘F6` | Next open document window |
| `⌘⇧F6` | Previous open document window |
| `⌘F4` | Close current document |
| `⌥⌘W` | Close all documents |
| `⇥` | Next comment/link/form field |
| `⇧⇥` | Previous comment/link/form field |
| `F5` | Move focus to document pane |
| `⌘F` | Find in document |
| `⌘G` | Next search result |

## Navigation Panels

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘⇧F5` | Open navigation pane |
| `→` | Expand bookmark |
| `←` | Collapse bookmark |
| `⇧*` | Expand all bookmarks |
| `/` | Collapse selected bookmark |

## Accessibility

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `F2` | Edit Tag |
| `⇧⌘5` | Change reading settings |
| `⌘4` | Reflow tagged PDF |
| `⇧⌘Y` | Activate/deactivate Read out loud |
| `⇧⌘V` | Read current page out loud |
| `⇧⌘B` | Read whole document out loud |
| `⇧⌘C` | Pause reading |
| `⇧⌘E` | Stop reading |

## Help

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `F1` | Open Acrobat user guide |
| `⌘W` | Close user guide |
| `⌘←` | Previous topic |
| `⌘→` | Next topic |
| `⌘P` | Print Help topic |

## Template file

The full [`acrobat.keyly`](https://github.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/blob/main/templates/acrobat.keyly) file. Copy it into `~/.config/keyly/templates/` to edit it, or [write your own](/configuration/custom-shortcuts/).
